summary: Braskem S.A. files a management proposal for an Extraordinary General Meeting on 2026-05-28 regarding a transaction where NSP Investimentos will sell to Shine I FIP approximately 50.11% of common shares and 13.71% of Class A preferred shares, representing 34.32% of total capital stock. A new shareholders' agreement between Petrobras and the FIP establishes balanced governance with equal board and officer nomination rights. The judicial sale is subject to conditions precedent and judicial authorizations. The meeting seeks to reformulate bylaws to reflect the new governance. Watch for regulatory and court approvals.
